featured_reviews.name: Bhavya Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an amazing time at Shott! 🎳 The bowling experience was super fun, and the vibe of the place is just perfect for hanging out with friends. We had pre-booked our table, everything was well managed, and the food was really good too. Definitely coming back again!

featured_reviews.name: Kalyani Kasat
featured_reviews.review_text: Such a fun experience at Shott Playing Zone! Bowling and laser wars were super exciting, and we had an amazing time. Also, the French fries were really tasty!🤩🤩

featured_reviews.name: Ashwini Godbole
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an amazing time at SHOTT Mumbai! The bowling, arcade games, and overall vibe were fantastic. The place is well-maintained, the staff is helpful, and there are plenty of activities to keep everyone entertained. Perfect spot for a fun outing with friends, family, or even a date. The food and drinks were great too. Definitely looking forward to visiting again! 🎳

featured_reviews.name: Chandu B
featured_reviews.review_text: Extremely disappointing experience. The staff aggressively pushes you to buy a game card with a minimum recharge of ₹3,100 instead of clearly explaining the available options. The combo packages are poorly designed and misleading they ended up charging us more than the advertised combo prices. To make matters worse, one of the combos included “5 arcade games,” but the card only worked on a limited selection of arcade machines. Many of the games we actually wanted to play either weren’t covered by the combo or weren’t functional at all. Paying a premium only to find several machines out of service made the experience feel like terrible value for money. Definitely not what you’d expect from a place that’s marketed as a premium entertainment destination. Most of the 5 stars reviews are definitely fake!

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Rajeshirke
featured_reviews.review_text: Best experience and worth it. Had so much fun with friends. Also the staff is very humble and helpful.

featured_reviews.name: Aishwarya chellath
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a really good experience . The vibe is great, music was nice, and the staff was super friendly and attentive. Food and drinks were fresh and well presented. Perfect place to chill with friends and have a fun evening. Would definitely visit again!

featured_reviews.name: Pratap Vashodiya
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited Shott Mumbai and had an amazing time playing their arcade games. The place has a lively vibe with a wide variety of games, from racing and shooting to classic arcade machines. What made my experience even more exciting was winning bonus tickets while playing. The thrill of collecting tickets after each win kept me fully engaged and added a fun competitive edge. Eventually, I redeemed my tickets and got a cool gift, which made the whole experience even more rewarding. The staff was friendly and helpful, guiding me through the games and redemption process. Overall, it was a fun-filled and memorable outing, perfect for hanging out with friends or just enjoying some solo gaming time. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for entertainment in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.review_text: Played pool here for an hour for ₹600. It’s a great spot to relax and have fun. They also have a food and drink counter, so you don’t need to step out for snacks. Plus, there are PC and console games available too! Overall, a cool place to hang out with friends.

featured_reviews.name: Swayam Thanekar
featured_reviews.review_text: Would not recommend this place what so ever. The person sitting at the counter did not bother. half of the pcs were not working, even the working pcs were not in good condition. We had to wait 40 mins to get our pcs working and when we requested him to extend the time he refused so we had to get full refund and left the place without even playing.

featured_reviews.name: Shubham Powale
featured_reviews.review_text: Terrible experience at AIM Gaming Café. We went as a group of 5 and faced multiple issues: one PC wasn’t grounded properly and kept shocking my friend, CS2 wasn’t installed, systems had to be restarted repeatedly (losing 40 minutes), and the peripherals were poor — broken mics and low-quality headphones. The counter staff was unprofessional and initially refused to compensate us, though we eventually got a refund. Not worth your time.

featured_reviews.review_text: Game times are extremely strict to the second, mouse gear isn't good, even 60rs cafes have a g102 in PC. the monitor was set to 60hz by default and since they had hidden the settings app god knows why, I had to spend 15 minutes of my game time figuring out how to enable the 240hz which I paid for and no one in support knew how to do it. Absolutely DO NOT recommend if you're serious about gaming, for casual hangouts it's chill.  Price is also egregious, 150rs for an hour in a midrange PC setup is daylight robbery.

Tried Zero Latency and honestly… WOW 🤯🔥

featured_reviews.name: Shoaa Shams
featured_reviews.review_text: I had an absolutely thrilling time at Zero Latency Mumbai! Played Outbreak: Zombie for 30 minutes and the experience was next level. The free-roam VR, realistic weapons, and spine-chilling zombie attacks made it feel like I was living inside a movie. Super immersive, adrenaline-pumping, and a must-try for anyone who loves gaming and thrill. The staff was very polite, the environment was friendly i just wish the Zero Latency team could work on pricing. Its a little bit on the expensice side. But the overall experience is worth it!

featured_reviews.name: Kris Camponi
featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing experience, went today with my son and we had the place to ourselves. Played Far Cry VR. The staff are really helpful and everything is as immersive as you’d expect. Will go again. Thanks to the team for making it so good.

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Jekte
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely thrilling experience!
Honestly felt like I was right in the middle of a real zombie apocalypse. It's a total must-try! On top of the amazing setup, the staff members were incredibly helpful and provided fantastic customer service. Highly recommended!.

featured_reviews.name: Shashank Saxena
featured_reviews.review_text: If you enjoy VR gaming, this is heaven for you. However, if you are playing for the first time, I cannot say that you will not enjoy this place because the gaming experience you will have is one that you will remember for the rest of your life. The executive was also polite and helpful, and they are good photographers, I must say. Everything was perfect, but the customer may encounter some parking issues, so they should work on it.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I went here for some afternoon bowling, but it was quite crowded. There was about a one-hour wait, which is understandable. However, when my turn finally came, I wanted to add one more person to our lane. Unfortunately, the staff wasn't flexible and refused, saying "already booking hai nahi hoga" (already booked, can't happen). It felt a bit rigid, especially since they weren't taking additional players later on either.

For bowling, I'd recommend going on a weekday and arriving early to avoid the wait. Otherwise, you might consider other bowling alleys like Smaaash, where I've had an overall better experience.
